observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability-intelligence and incremental coherence

outcome.effectiveness_assessment: Bounded trigger-context and Store replay diagnostic paths are implemented and regression-verified. The selected-session readback contains no non-empty live semantic-subject relation. The costly tick and its I/O source remain unresolved.
outcome.interpretation_limit: No claim is made that this change reduced agent effort, service latency, or filesystem I/O.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient owner traces lose trigger context and Store replay reporting can crash
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment coherence routing and ECI compaction
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The baseline selected-session ECI summary used schema 3 and had no semantic-subject fields. A later resident attempt ended with KeyError while updating Store replay diagnostics after a route or observation failure.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve bounded sanitized routed subjects and trigger kinds with exact service execution identity; initialize replay diagnostics before fallible routing; measure stage resource cost without attributing the observed I/O to a specific subsystem.

improvement_relation.basis: Targeted suites cover bounded semantic-subject routing, zero-subject trigger-kind retention, old summary readability, and Store replay diagnostic survival. The post-change ECI readback shows schema 4 and an explicit zero-subject detail for the selected session.
not_measured: Whether agents needed or received the sampled services.
Whether non-empty semantic subject links occur in current operational triggers.
Whether the change reduced agent intervention, service I/O, or latency.
Why the resident pass sample caused 405254144 process write bytes.

measurement_limits: The live readback has no non-empty trigger evidence, so practical benefit of subject correlation is not demonstrated yet.
The regression covers the observed missing-diagnostic class through controlled failure injection, not the source of the measured resident-pass resource use.
Ambient fulfillment, agent receipt, correctness, and intervention burden remain unmeasured.
